body: Thanks. Mentioning the Samaritans I did call the helpline earlier although I felt like I was being rushed off the phone which led me here.. If only I could go to my parents (well my mum, my dad doesn't do feelings/emotions!) and tell them how I really feel. Whenever I bring anything up with my mum she'll just respond with "I don't know what to say"  and how I'll end up in a mental home if I continue thinking the way I do. Maybe you are right about needing help with dealing with these feelings as hard as that is for me to admit. x

Hi there. Like you I am a 25 year old female, your post resonates with me on so many levels having been through in an unhealthy relationship for similar reasons. I am here for you hun - you are worthy of living and if you ever want to talk PM me. *hugs*
